title: Two push modes: (1) tws sync <feature> --push pushes all successfully synced branches with --force-with-lease after sync completes. (2) tws push <feature> as a standalone command that pushes all branches in the stack with --force-with-lease. Should only push branches that have diverged from their remote tracking branch. Support --dry-run to preview what would be pushed. Update skills to document both push workflows.
